parameters.query:
WITH dados AS (
  SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb)
    AS x(id int, descricao text, id_pop int, fabricante_modelo text, busca_potencia text, ativo text)
), up AS (
  INSERT INTO olts (id, descricao, id_pop, fabricante_modelo, busca_potencia, ativo, atualizado_em)
  SELECT id, descricao, id_pop, fabricante_modelo, busca_potencia, ativo, now() FROM dados
  ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
    descricao = EXCLUDED.descricao, id_pop = EXCLUDED.id_pop,
    fabricante_modelo = EXCLUDED.fabricante_modelo, busca_potencia = EXCLUDED.busca_potencia,
    ativo = EXCLUDED.ativo, atualizado_em = now()
  RETURNING id
), del AS (
  DELETE FROM olts WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM dados) > 0 AND id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM dados) RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO sync_log (fluxo, inicio, fim, registros, status, obs)
VALUES ('olts', $2::timestamptz, now(), (SELECT count(*) FROM up), 'ok',
        'removidas: ' || (SELECT count(*) FROM del))
RETURNING fluxo, registros, obs;
